ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Double Extension File Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious use of an .exe extension after a non-executable file extension like .pdf.exe, a set of spaces or underlines to cloak the executable file in spear phishing campaigns

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\ \\ \\ \\ \\ \\ \\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.doc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.doc\\\.js$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.docx\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.docx\\\.js$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.gif\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.jpeg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.jpg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.mkv\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.mov\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.mp3\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\.mp4\\\.exe$") OR
